item.title: Govt keeps petrol price unchanged, raises diesel by Rs3 per litre
item.description: The federal government kept the price of petrol unchanged for the next fortnight and increased the price of high-speed diesel by Rs3 per litre, the finance division said in a notification.

item.title: Lahore schools to hold online classes on Mondays as smog worsens
item.description: The Punjab government extended its smog plan, moving Monday classes at Lahore schools online and pausing outdoor sports.

item.title: Selectors rest two senior pacers, pick three new faces for home Tests
item.description: Selectors rested two senior fast bowlers and picked three uncapped players for the Test series opener in Rawalpindi.

item.title: NEPRA hears plea for fuel charge adjustment on electricity bills
item.description: The power regulator heard a request from distribution companies to pass last quarter's fuel costs on to consumers and reserved its decision.
